numbers.source_quote: 发行可转换公司债券 3,800,000 张
募集资金总额为人民币 380,000,000 元
扣除承销及保荐费 5,550,000.00 元
实际收到的金额为 374,450,000 元
实际募集资金净额为 372,479,593.35 元
本次募集资金各项发行费用合计752.04万元
公司已用自筹资金支付的发行费用金额为120.15万元
(derived) 承销保荐费 5,550,000 + 其他发行费用 1,970,406.65
(derived) 补流调整差额 11,400.00 − 10,647.96 万元

key_points.point: Total raised 380,000,000 yuan = 3,800,000 bonds × 100 yuan face; less underwriting/sponsorship fees 5,550,000.00 → 374,450,000 actually received; less other direct issuance costs 1,970,406.65 → net proceeds 372,479,593.35 - the three-tier chain reconciles
Total issuance costs 752.04 万元 (ex-VAT) match the sum of the two deductions: 5,550,000 + 1,970,406.65 = 7,520,406.65 yuan ≈ 752.04 万元 - a cross-unit (yuan/万元) reconciliation (derived)

The working-capital/loan-repayment line was cut from 11,400.00 to 10,647.96 万元 (the Guinea project untouched); the 752.04 万元 gap exactly equals total issuance costs - the shortfall of net proceeds versus the original 38,000 万元 plan is entirely the fees, absorbed by the working-capital line (derived)

Replacement covers: 20,049.10 万元 of self-raised funds pre-invested in the project (fully replaced) plus 120.15 万元 of pre-paid issuance fees; the four fee lines sum to 120.16 万元 vs the disclosed 120.15 - a 0.01 万元 rounding artifact of the source, within tolerance

Approved by the 11th meeting of the 4th board; within board authority, NO shareholder vote required; sponsor Guolian Minsheng issued an explicit consent opinion and Pan-China (天健) issued the capital-verification report

notes: The five-step reconciliation chain is the crux: count×face; three-tier deductions; cross-unit fee reconciliation (N11 derived); the hidden identity - the working-capital cut of 752.04 万元 exactly equals total issuance costs (N12 derived, the deep-understanding marker); and the fee-detail sum where 120.16 vs 120.15 is a source rounding artifact - declaring a disclosure contradiction is an over-reaction (same lesson as MB-022's rounded EPS). Yuan and 万元 are mixed within one filing; unit slips lose points. Anti-template procedure: no shareholder vote needed. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
